info.title: GovCon Shipley Black Hat Incumbent Ghosting API
info.description: Conducts a Shipley Black-Hat competitive intelligence simulation on a target solicitation and incumbent contractor, profiling likely competitor bidding strategies and wrap-rate postures, generating verbatim ethical ghosting statements mapped to RFP Section L/M evaluation factors, neutralizing incumbent transition advantages, and drafting Contracting Officer Q&A shaping questions. Stateless, read-only, and idempotent.

post.summary: Generate GovCon Black-Hat Competitive Review & Ethical Ghosting Statements
post.description: Simulates competitor bidding strategies, exposes incumbent recompete vulnerabilities, and generates Shipley ethical ghosting statements, CO shaping questions, and Red Team scoring triggers.

solicitation_and_incumbent_context_text.description: Target RFP scope, Section M evaluation weights, incumbent contractor name/PIID, historical award ceiling, known incumbent pain points (SLA misses, turnover, legacy tech debt), and likely competitor bidders.

bidder_discriminators_and_proof_points.description: Bidder's technical discriminators, proprietary accelerators, past performance metrics, socio-economic status, and wrap-rate / PTW advantages.

evaluation_type_and_posture.description: Capture posture and source selection method (e.g., Challenger Unseating Incumbent under Best-Value Tradeoff, Incumbent Defending Recompete, or LPTA).

example.solicitation_and_incumbent_context_text: Target Recompete: DoD C5ISR Enterprise Cloud & 24x7 Cyber SOC Operations ($85M 5-Year Single-Award Task Order). Section M Evaluation: Best-Value Tradeoff (Factor 1 Technical Approach [Most Important] > Factor 2 Management & Transition > Factor 3 Past Performance > Price). Incumbent: LegacyDefense Corp (held contract for 5 years; known pain points include 18% annual SOC analyst turnover, delayed RMF cATO pipeline, and high 2.15x Tier-1 wrap rate). Other Likely Bidders: BeltwayScale SI (aggressive price cutter using junior LCATs).
